title: Guinermod
description: Survive a world invaded by the Guiners, new daylight enemies that spawn in large groups, and much more.
body:
![3 Guiner structures in a desert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/437de246d047e91e7ffaa6576ac2233048facad2.png)
An invasive species called "Guiners" have invaded the Minecraft world, they have filled the beautiful green plains and savannas with their bizarre brick structures, and have waged war against the players for some reason.

**Guiners are enemies that appear in large groups when the sun is directly above you or inside overworld structures made out of bricks. They are extremely weak, most of them dying with two hits with your bare hands, but new and stronger Guiner enemies will start appearing the more of them you kill, so you better gear up!**

Discover their structures and craft brick tools! or don't! they suck and break in one hit but they do a lot of knockback and can be fun to use.

![Rogues gallery featuring the Guiners and a final mysterious mob...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28179c5fd3bdd8780f18875dc597f68db8353e5c.png)
You have the **standard Guiner**, the **tall Guiner**, the **Chameleon**, the **Flinger robots**, the **Guiner Flying Machines**, **Homonculi**, the **Guinermothers**, and the mastermind behind this invasion... hiding away in _a separate plane of reality_.

But the Guiners didn't come alone.
With them, a series of new creatures entered your world aswell:
The dangerous **Bunnoids** from the Blue Forest, the **Colossal Ogres** that spawn during the night, and **Flingers... again!** Because they also spawn on their own during the night.
![Newmobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84766b55f9936b59e5e29baa8ecd0b2a746df737.png)
Oh yeah, and I skipped past the Bonnoids, the Bunnoids smarter and friendlier cousins polished from thunder, try to create one during thunderstorms and befriend it using that strange fruit you find everywhere in the Blue Forest.

_Credits: Vargskelethor Joel, Siivagunner, Moranbong Band, WildBrain, Cinemassacre._
